subject: Biomedica SIG/CAIQ intake — scheduling, Q&A, and artifact requests
messages:
From: Max Torres <max.torres@biomedica.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: security@biomedica.com, Gwen Patel <gwen.patel@biomedica.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG/CAIQ intake + artifacts for evaluation

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Biomedica's security team would like to kick off a SIG/CAIQ intake to validate network isolation and logging for our upcoming pilot. Our main asks are:

- A short intake call to walk through the CAIQ map and confirm who owns which artifacts.
- A sample of log exports (anonymized) for routing and retention verification.
- A quick Q&A on encryption key management and private deployment options.

Can you confirm availability for a 45-minute call next week (we're PST-based, pref 10:00-14:00 PT)? Also, please send a link to any questionnaire mapping you maintain and an initial list of artifacts we should prepare.

Thanks,
Max Torres
Security Operations Manager
Biomedica Therapeutics
--
Attachment: biomedica-intake-request.pdf (application/pdf, 78KB)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Max Torres <max.torres@biomedica.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ intake + artifacts for evaluation

Max — great to hear from you. We'll take this on. Proposed plan:

1) Intake call (45m) to run through CAIQ + SIG scope and confirm artifact owners.
2) Follow-up evidence handoff (secure link) where we'll drop the requested samples.
3) One technical follow-up for any deeper infra questions.

Availability (PT): Wed 05/20 10:30 or Thu 05/21 11:00 — please pick one and we will send a calendar invite.

Irene (security lead) and Marissa (compliance ops) are cc'd and will own artifact mapping and log sample delivery. Vivek from solutions will join for any private deployment questions.

Initial artifact list (what we typically provide):
- CAIQ mapped answers (CSV + human-readable)
- SOC 2 summary and scoped controls (redacted where necessary)
- Example audit log export (1 week sample, redacted)
- Network diagram showing VPC/peering and ingress controls
- KMS / key rotation policy excerpt

We will attach our SIG cover letter and a short checklist to this thread once I confirm the invite.

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
Head of Partnerships — Redwood Inference
--
Attachment: redwood-sig-cover-letter.pdf (application/pdf, 42KB)
From: Max Torres <max.torres@biomedica.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: security@biomedica.com, Gwen Patel <gwen.patel@biomedica.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ intake + artifacts for evaluation

Jonas — thanks. Thu 05/21 11:00 PT works for us. Please send a calendar invite with a Zoom link.

A couple of clarifications ahead of the call so we can prep: 
- For the audit log sample, we need at least one week and a note on retention policy for endpoint and inference logs.
- Can you confirm whether KMS keys for "Private" deployments can be customer-managed (BYOK) and whether HSM-backed keys are supported?
- Any non-prod access to customer data during onboarding? We need to understand who has access and how it is controlled.

I'll prep our questionnaire and share it prior to the call.

Max

Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ intake + artifacts for evaluation — notes & action items

Thanks again for the call today — notes and action items below. I recorded the call per mutual consent and dropped the recording to the Drive link included in related_links.

Meeting notes (Thu 2026-05-21 11:00 PT):
- Attendees: Max Torres (Biomedica), Gwen Patel (Biomedica), Jonas Weber (Redwood), Irene Choi (Redwood), Marissa Cole (Redwood), Vivek Kulkarni (Redwood).
- Scope: SIG Lite + CAIQ focused on Logging, Key Management, VPC isolation, and evidence transfer for pilot.

Technical clarifications covered:
- KMS/BYOK: Private deployment supports customer-managed keys via AWS KMS integration; HSM-backed (CloudHSM) can be used for enterprise contracts. Irene to attach KMS integration guide.
- Non-prod data access: Redwood engineers may access anonymized traces during onboarding for debugging under least-privilege, logged via access audit. No raw customer data is accessed without consent.
- Logs: We provide application + inference logs. Typical retention 90 days by default; configurable for Dedicated/Private. Sample provided is a 7-day redacted export.
- Network: VPC peering is available; network diagram will show peering and NAT gateways used.

Action items (owners / due):
- Irene Choi: Share KMS integration guide and CAIQ mapped answers (by 2026-05-24).
- Marissa Cole: Upload SOC 2 scope summary and sample audit logs to secure Drive (redwood-logs-sample.tar.gz) (by 2026-05-24).
- Jonas Weber: Send cover letter + checklist and HS record id for tracking (HS-1234567) (by 2026-05-21 end of day).
- Max Torres: Send Biomedica questionnaire and confirm any additional artifact requests (by 2026-05-23).

Attachments added to Drive: redwood-sig-cover-letter.pdf, redwood-logs-sample.tar.gz

If anything above is incorrect or missing, please reply-all with corrections. We'll operate on the timeline above to avoid delaying the pilot kickoff.

Best,
Jonas
Head of Partnerships — Redwood Inference
